description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Delta Pipeline, Inc. is hiring an Associate Application Developer to build and maintain internal business applications using the Microsoft Power Platform and modern web technologies. The role works directly with software users to turn business needs into tools, with early ownership of projects and mentorship from the Director of Technology.
Associate Application Developer building and maintaining internal business applications with Microsoft Power Platform and modern web technologies

Responsibilities:
• Build and maintain internal business applications on the Microsoft Power Platform and modern web technologies
• Take ownership of real systems early, with a first project that ships company-wide in your first months
• Work directly with the people who use the software, in the office and in the field, to turn business needs into working tools
• Learn alongside the Director of Technology at first, then run your own work with a written growth plan

Requirements:
• Graduating December 2026 (or recently graduated) in Computer Science,
Information Systems, Software Engineering or similar
• a strong portfolio counts as much as the major
• You have built something, on your own or with AI tools, and can walk us
through it end to end: what it does, how the data is shaped, what broke, what
you would change
• Comfortable with any programming language and with using AI coding tools as
part of how you work

Preferred:
• JavaScript or React, any Power Platform, Node, C#, Python or
SharePoint experience
• construction or trades background
